package unit

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
)

func TestValidateTaskContractAcceptsMeaningfulHTMLRules(t *testing.T) {
	codeStructure := json.RawMessage(`{
		"rules": {
			"doctype": true,
			"body": {
				"required_children": [
					{ "tag": "h1" }
				]
			}
		}
	}`)

	if err := domain.ValidateTaskContract(domain.TaskTypeFrontendPreview, codeStructure); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected html rules to be accepted, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestValidateTaskContractAcceptsLegacyRulesWithTopLevelVersion(t *testing.T) {
	codeStructure := json.RawMessage(`{
		"type": "css_stylesheet",
		"version": 1,
		"rules": {
			"required_selectors": [
				{
					"selector": "h1",
					"required_properties": ["color"]
				}
			]
		}
	}`)

	if err := domain.ValidateTaskContract(domain.TaskTypeFrontendPreview, codeStructure); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected legacy contract with version to be accepted, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestValidateTaskContractRejectsStarterFilesOnly(t *testing.T) {
	codeStructure := json.RawMessage(`{
		"rules": {
			"required_files": [
				{ "path": "index.html" }
			]
		}
	}`)

	if err := domain.ValidateTaskContract(domain.TaskTypeFrontendPreview, codeStructure); err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected starter-only contract to be rejected")
	}
}

func TestValidateTaskContractAcceptsNextRules(t *testing.T) {
	codeStructure := json.RawMessage(`{
		"rules": {
			"required_pages": [
				{ "path": "app/page.tsx", "contains": "Welcome to Next.js" }
			],
			"uses_app_directory": true
		}
	}`)

	if err := domain.ValidateTaskContract(domain.TaskTypeFullstackPage, codeStructure); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected next rules to be accepted, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestValidateTaskContractAcceptsReactExpectedComponentRules(t *testing.T) {
	codeStructure := json.RawMessage(`{
		"type": "react_component",
		"entry_files": ["App.jsx"],
		"expected_component": {
			"name": "App",
			"kind": "function",
			"return_tree": {
				"tag": "h1",
				"text_equals_any": ["Hello, React!"]
			}
		}
	}`)

	if err := domain.ValidateTaskContract(domain.TaskTypeFrontendPreview, codeStructure); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected react contract to be accepted, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestValidateTaskContractAcceptsPHPConstructAndClassRules(t *testing.T) {
	constructCodeStructure := json.RawMessage(`{
		"rules": {
			"required_constructs": [
				{"type": "echo", "text_equals": "Hello, World!"}
			]
		}
	}`)

	if err := domain.ValidateTaskContract(domain.TaskTypeFullstackPage, constructCodeStructure); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected php construct rules to be accepted, got %v", err)
	}

	classCodeStructure := json.RawMessage(`{
		"rules": {
			"required_classes": [
				{"name": "User", "properties": ["name"], "methods": [{"name": "introduce"}]}
			]
		}
	}`)

	if err := domain.ValidateTaskContract(domain.TaskTypeFullstackPage, classCodeStructure); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected php class rules to be accepted, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestValidateTaskContractAcceptsQuizAndTestWithoutCodeStructure(t *testing.T) {
	if err := domain.ValidateTaskContract(domain.TaskTypeQuizTheory, nil); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected quiz task to skip code structure validation, got %v", err)
	}
	if err := domain.ValidateTaskContract(domain.TaskTypeTest, nil); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected test task to skip code structure validation, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestValidateTaskContractAcceptsValidationContractV1(t *testing.T) {
	codeStructure := json.RawMessage(`{
		"version": 1,
		"kind": "workspace_contract",
		"workspace": {
			"required_files": ["index.html", "styles.css"]
		},
		"stages": [
			{
				"id": "html",
				"engine": "html.dom",
				"targets": {
					"files": ["index.html"]
				}
			},
			{
				"id": "css",
				"engine": "css.ast",
				"depends_on": ["html"],
				"targets": {
					"files": ["styles.css"]
				}
			}
		],
		"links": [
			{
				"id": "selector-exists",
				"kind": "workspace.selector_exists",
				"depends_on": ["html"]
			}
		]
	}`)

	if err := domain.ValidateTaskContract(domain.TaskTypeFrontendPreview, codeStructure); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected validation contract v1 to be accepted, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestValidateTaskContractRejectsValidationContractWithoutStages(t *testing.T) {
	codeStructure := json.RawMessage(`{
		"version": 1,
		"kind": "workspace_contract",
		"workspace": {
			"required_files": ["index.html"]
		}
	}`)

	if err := domain.ValidateTaskContract(domain.TaskTypeFrontendPreview, codeStructure); err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected validation contract without stages to be rejected")
	}
}

func TestValidateTaskContractRejectsValidationContractUnknownDependency(t *testing.T) {
	codeStructure := json.RawMessage(`{
		"version": 1,
		"kind": "workspace_contract",
		"stages": [
			{
				"id": "css",
				"engine": "css.ast",
				"depends_on": ["html"]
			}
		]
	}`)

	if err := domain.ValidateTaskContract(domain.TaskTypeFrontendPreview, codeStructure); err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected validation contract with unknown dependency to be rejected")
	}
}

func TestValidateTaskContractRejectsStageDependencyUnavailableInFinalMode(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()

	codeStructure := json.RawMessage(`{
		"version": 1,
		"kind": "workspace_contract",
		"stages": [
			{
				"id": "php-structure",
				"engine": "php.core",
				"mode": "live",
				"rules": {"requiredTokens": ["echo"]}
			},
			{
				"id": "exact-output",
				"engine": "linux.runtime",
				"mode": "final",
				"depends_on": ["php-structure"],
				"checks": {"commands": [{"command": ["php", "index.php"]}]}
			}
		]
	}`)

	if err := domain.ValidateTaskContract(domain.TaskTypeCLIProgramming, codeStructure); err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected final stage dependency on live-only stage to fail")
	}
}

func TestValidateTaskContractAcceptsBothStageAsFinalDependency(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()

	codeStructure := json.RawMessage(`{
		"version": 1,
		"kind": "workspace_contract",
		"stages": [
			{
				"id": "php-structure",
				"engine": "php.core",
				"mode": "both",
				"rules": {"requiredTokens": ["echo"]}
			},
			{
				"id": "exact-output",
				"engine": "linux.runtime",
				"mode": "final",
				"depends_on": ["php-structure"],
				"checks": {"commands": [{"command": ["php", "index.php"]}]}
			}
		]
	}`)

	if err := domain.ValidateTaskContract(domain.TaskTypeCLIProgramming, codeStructure); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected both stage to satisfy final dependency: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestValidateTaskContractAcceptsTypeScriptRuntimeComposite(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()

	if err := domain.ValidateTaskContract(domain.TaskTypeCLIProgramming, validTypeScriptRuntimeContract()); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected TypeScript runtime contract to be accepted, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestValidateTaskContractRejectsUnsafeTypeScriptRuntimeContract(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()

	cases := map[string]func(map[string]any){
		"runtime is not final": func(stage map[string]any) {
			stage["mode"] = "both"
		},
		"runtime has no static dependency": func(stage map[string]any) {
			stage["depends_on"] = []any{}
		},
		"entrypoint escapes workspace": func(stage map[string]any) {
			stage["targets"] = map[string]any{"files": []any{"../main.ts"}, "entrypoint": "../main.ts"}
		},
		"runtime accepts authored command": func(stage map[string]any) {
			stage["checks"].(map[string]any)["command"] = []any{"node", "main.ts"}
		},
		"runtime has no output assertion": func(stage map[string]any) {
			stage["checks"].(map[string]any)["expect"] = map[string]any{"exitCode": float64(0)}
		},
		"runtime has invalid exit code": func(stage map[string]any) {
			stage["checks"].(map[string]any)["expect"].(map[string]any)["exitCode"] = float64(256)
		},
	}

	for name, mutate := range cases {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			var contract map[string]any
			if err := json.Unmarshal(validTypeScriptRuntimeContract(), &contract); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("decode valid TypeScript runtime contract: %v", err)
			}
			stages := contract["stages"].([]any)
			mutate(stages[1].(map[string]any))
			encoded, err := json.Marshal(contract)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("encode mutated TypeScript runtime contract: %v", err)
			}
			if err := domain.ValidateTaskContract(domain.TaskTypeCLIProgramming, encoded); err == nil {
				t.Fatalf("expected unsafe TypeScript runtime contract to be rejected")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestValidateTaskContractAcceptsJavaCompileRuntimeComposite(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()

	if err := domain.ValidateTaskContract(domain.TaskTypeCLIProgramming, validJavaRuntimeContract()); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected Java runtime contract to be accepted, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestValidateTaskContractRejectsUnsafeJavaRuntimeContract(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()

	cases := map[string]func([]any){
		"compile is not both": func(stages []any) {
			stages[0].(map[string]any)["mode"] = "final"
		},
		"compile accepts checks": func(stages []any) {
			stages[0].(map[string]any)["checks"] = map[string]any{}
		},
		"compile depends on runtime": func(stages []any) {
			stages[0].(map[string]any)["depends_on"] = []any{"runtime"}
		},
		"runtime is not final": func(stages []any) {
			stages[1].(map[string]any)["mode"] = "both"
		},
		"runtime has no compile dependency": func(stages []any) {
			stages[1].(map[string]any)["depends_on"] = []any{}
		},
		"runtime has an extra dependency": func(stages []any) {
			stages[1].(map[string]any)["depends_on"] = []any{"compile", "runtime"}
		},
		"entrypoint is not exact Main.java": func(stages []any) {
			stages[1].(map[string]any)["targets"] = map[string]any{"files": []any{"src/Main.java"}, "entrypoint": "src/Main.java"}
		},
		"runtime accepts authored command": func(stages []any) {
			stages[1].(map[string]any)["checks"].(map[string]any)["command"] = []any{"java", "Main"}
		},
		"runtime has nonempty rules": func(stages []any) {
			stages[1].(map[string]any)["rules"] = map[string]any{"classpath": []any{"lib.jar"}}
		},
		"runtime has too many fragments": func(stages []any) {
			fragments := make([]any, 17)
			for index := range fragments {
				fragments[index] = "x"
			}
			stages[1].(map[string]any)["checks"].(map[string]any)["expect"] = map[string]any{
				"exitCode":       float64(0),
				"stdoutContains": fragments,
			}
		},
		"compile stage is replaced": func(stages []any) {
			stages[0].(map[string]any)["engine"] = "js.ast"
		},
	}

	for name, mutate := range cases {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			var contract map[string]any
			if err := json.Unmarshal(validJavaRuntimeContract(), &contract); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("decode valid Java runtime contract: %v", err)
			}
			stages := contract["stages"].([]any)
			mutate(stages)
			encoded, err := json.Marshal(contract)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("encode mutated Java runtime contract: %v", err)
			}
			if err := domain.ValidateTaskContract(domain.TaskTypeCLIProgramming, encoded); err == nil {
				t.Fatalf("expected unsafe Java runtime contract to be rejected")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestValidateTaskContractRejectsJavaValidationLinks(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()

	var contract map[string]any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(validJavaRuntimeContract(), &contract); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("decode valid Java runtime contract: %v", err)
	}
	contract["links"] = []any{
		map[string]any{"id": "extra", "kind": "workspace.file_contains", "depends_on": []any{"compile"}},
	}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(contract)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("encode Java runtime contract with link: %v", err)
	}
	if err := domain.ValidateTaskContract(domain.TaskTypeCLIProgramming, encoded); err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected Java runtime validation links to be rejected")
	}
}

func TestValidateTaskContractRejectsUnsafeKotlinRuntimeContract(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()

	cases := map[string]func([]any){
		"compile is not both": func(stages []any) {
			stages[0].(map[string]any)["mode"] = "final"
		},
		"compile accepts checks": func(stages []any) {
			stages[0].(map[string]any)["checks"] = map[string]any{}
		},
		"compile depends on runtime": func(stages []any) {
			stages[0].(map[string]any)["depends_on"] = []any{"runtime"}
		},
		"runtime is not final": func(stages []any) {
			stages[1].(map[string]any)["mode"] = "both"
		},
		"runtime has no compile dependency": func(stages []any) {
			stages[1].(map[string]any)["depends_on"] = []any{}
		},
		"runtime has an extra dependency": func(stages []any) {
			stages[1].(map[string]any)["depends_on"] = []any{"compile", "runtime"}
		},
		"entrypoint is not exact Main.kt": func(stages []any) {
			stages[1].(map[string]any)["targets"] = map[string]any{"files": []any{"src/Main.kt"}, "entrypoint": "src/Main.kt"}
		},
		"runtime accepts authored command": func(stages []any) {
			stages[1].(map[string]any)["checks"].(map[string]any)["command"] = []any{"kotlin", "Main"}
		},
		"runtime has nonempty rules": func(stages []any) {
			stages[1].(map[string]any)["rules"] = map[string]any{"classpath": []any{"lib.jar"}}
		},
		"runtime has too many fragments": func(stages []any) {
			fragments := make([]any, 17)
			for index := range fragments {
				fragments[index] = "x"
			}
			stages[1].(map[string]any)["checks"].(map[string]any)["expect"] = map[string]any{
				"exitCode":       float64(0),
				"stdoutContains": fragments,
			}
		},
		"compile stage is replaced": func(stages []any) {
			stages[0].(map[string]any)["engine"] = "js.ast"
		},
	}

	for name, mutate := range cases {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			var contract map[string]any
			if err := json.Unmarshal(validKotlinRuntimeContract(), &contract); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("decode valid Kotlin runtime contract: %v", err)
			}
			stages := contract["stages"].([]any)
			mutate(stages)
			encoded, err := json.Marshal(contract)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("encode mutated Kotlin runtime contract: %v", err)
			}
			if err := domain.ValidateTaskContract(domain.TaskTypeCLIProgramming, encoded); err == nil {
				t.Fatalf("expected unsafe Kotlin runtime contract to be rejected")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestValidateTaskContractRejectsKotlinValidationLinks(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()

	var contract map[string]any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(validKotlinRuntimeContract(), &contract); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("decode valid Kotlin runtime contract: %v", err)
	}
	contract["links"] = []any{
		map[string]any{"id": "extra", "kind": "workspace.file_contains", "depends_on": []any{"compile"}},
	}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(contract)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("encode Kotlin runtime contract with link: %v", err)
	}
	if err := domain.ValidateTaskContract(domain.TaskTypeCLIProgramming, encoded); err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected Kotlin runtime validation links to be rejected")
	}
}

func TestValidateTaskContractAcceptsBrowserRuntimeComposite(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()

	if err := domain.ValidateTaskContract(domain.TaskTypeFrontendPreview, validBrowserRuntimeContract()); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected browser runtime contract to be accepted, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestValidateTaskContractRejectsUnsafeBrowserRuntimeContract(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()

	cases := map[string]func(map[string]any, []any){
		"wrong task shape": func(contract map[string]any, _ []any) {
			contract["profile"] = "custom-browser"
		},
		"runtime is live": func(_ map[string]any, stages []any) {
			stages[2].(map[string]any)["mode"] = "both"
		},
		"runtime omits static dependency": func(_ map[string]any, stages []any) {
			stages[2].(map[string]any)["depends_on"] = []any{"html"}
		},
		"unsupported action": func(_ map[string]any, stages []any) {
			checks := stages[2].(map[string]any)["checks"].(map[string]any)
			checks["interactions"].([]any)[0].(map[string]any)["action"] = "hover"
		},
		"input omits value": func(_ map[string]any, stages []any) {
			checks := stages[2].(map[string]any)["checks"].(map[string]any)
			delete(checks["interactions"].([]any)[0].(map[string]any), "value")
		},
		"invented check": func(_ map[string]any, stages []any) {
			stages[2].(map[string]any)["checks"].(map[string]any)["shell"] = "npm test"
		},
	}

	for name, mutate := range cases {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			var contract map[string]any
			if err := json.Unmarshal(validBrowserRuntimeContract(), &contract); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("decode valid browser runtime contract: %v", err)
			}
			stages := contract["stages"].([]any)
			mutate(contract, stages)
			encoded, err := json.Marshal(contract)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("encode mutated browser runtime contract: %v", err)
			}
			if err := domain.ValidateTaskContract(domain.TaskTypeFrontendPreview, encoded); err == nil {
				t.Fatalf("expected unsafe browser runtime contract to be rejected")
			}
		})
	}
}

func validTypeScriptRuntimeContract() json.RawMessage {
	return json.RawMessage(`{
		"version": 1,
		"kind": "workspace_contract",
		"workspace": {"required_files": ["main.ts"]},
		"stages": [
			{
				"id": "static",
				"engine": "ts.ast",
				"mode": "both",
				"targets": {"files": ["main.ts"], "entrypoint": "main.ts"}
			},
			{
				"id": "runtime",
				"engine": "ts.runtime",
				"mode": "final",
				"depends_on": ["static"],
				"targets": {"files": ["main.ts"], "entrypoint": "main.ts"},
				"checks": {
					"kind": "cli",
					"args": [],
					"timeoutMs": 3000,
					"expect": {"exitCode": 0, "stdoutEquals": "Hello, Ada!\\n"}
				}
			}
		]
	}`)
}

func validBrowserRuntimeContract() json.RawMessage {
	return json.RawMessage(`{
		"version": 1,
		"kind": "workspace_contract",
		"profile": "browser-runtime",
		"workspace": {"required_files": ["index.html", "app.js"]},
		"stages": [
			{
				"id": "html",
				"engine": "html.dom",
				"mode": "both",
				"targets": {"files": ["index.html"], "entrypoint": "index.html"},
				"rules": {"version": 2, "body": {"roots": [{"tag": {"value": "main"}}]}}
			},
			{
				"id": "script",
				"engine": "js.ast",
				"mode": "both",
				"targets": {"files": ["app.js"], "entrypoint": "app.js"},
				"rules": {"requiredDependencies": [], "forbiddenGlobals": [], "maxFileSizeKb": 32}
			},
			{
				"id": "browser",
				"engine": "browser.runtime",
				"mode": "final",
				"depends_on": ["html", "script"],
				"targets": {"files": ["index.html", "app.js"], "entrypoint": "index.html"},
				"checks": {
					"interactions": [{
						"selector": "#name",
						"action": "fill",
						"value": "Ada",
						"expectValue": {"value": "Ada"},
						"expectTextContains": {"selector": "#result", "value": "Hello, Ada!"}
					}]
				}
			}
		],
		"links": []
	}`)
}

func validJavaRuntimeContract() json.RawMessage {
	return json.RawMessage(`{
		"version": 1,
		"kind": "workspace_contract",
		"workspace": {"required_files": ["Main.java"]},
		"stages": [
			{
				"id": "compile",
				"engine": "java.compile",
				"mode": "both",
				"targets": {"files": ["Main.java"], "entrypoint": "Main.java"},
				"rules": {}
			},
			{
				"id": "runtime",
				"engine": "java.runtime",
				"mode": "final",
				"depends_on": ["compile"],
				"targets": {"files": ["Main.java"], "entrypoint": "Main.java"},
				"rules": {},
				"checks": {
					"kind": "cli",
					"args": [],
					"timeoutMs": 3000,
					"expect": {"exitCode": 0, "stdoutEquals": "Hello, Ada!\\n"}
				}
			}
		]
	}`)
}

func validKotlinRuntimeContract() json.RawMessage {
	return json.RawMessage(`{
		"version": 1,
		"kind": "workspace_contract",
		"workspace": {"required_files": ["Main.kt"]},
		"stages": [
			{
				"id": "compile",
				"engine": "kotlin.compile",
				"mode": "both",
				"targets": {"files": ["Main.kt"], "entrypoint": "Main.kt"},
				"rules": {}
			},
			{
				"id": "runtime",
				"engine": "kotlin.runtime",
				"mode": "final",
				"depends_on": ["compile"],
				"targets": {"files": ["Main.kt"], "entrypoint": "Main.kt"},
				"rules": {},
				"checks": {
					"kind": "cli",
					"args": [],
					"timeoutMs": 3000,
					"expect": {"exitCode": 0, "stdoutEquals": "Hello, Ada!\\n"}
				}
			}
		]
	}`)
}
